instruction: I'm putting together a setup-photo slide for the trainer. Take a new photo with Camera on the first phone and make sure the final filename is `training_setup_photo.jpg`. The `Trainer` contact on the second phone has the trainer's email. The first Linux machine has `/tmp/train/handoff.txt` with the deck purpose and package reference, and the second Linux machine has `/tmp/train/template.odp`. On the second Linux machine, use the local template to create `/tmp/train/deck.odp`, filling in the photo filename, trainer email, purpose, and package reference. Export it as `/tmp/train/training_deck.pdf`. Then leave an unsent Thunderbird draft to the trainer with that PDF attached; identify the PDF and include the package reference in the message.
surfaces: Camera/Simple Gallery Pro + Contacts + Impress + Thunderbird
